def.myWoOpen: Work orders you are primary responsible for whose work is still ahead (draft, planning, ready, in progress, on hold).
def.woOverdue: Work orders past their planned end (same rule as the work order module).
def.myWoToday: Work orders whose planned period includes today (local day) and that are not overdue.
def.myDiOpen: Requests you submitted, neither closed nor turned into a work order (queue “My requests”).
def.myDiAwaiting: Your requests returned for clarification: they are waiting for your answer.
def.roundOverdue: Rounds assigned to you, still to do (scheduled, released, in progress) whose planned time is past (same rule as the Inspections module).
def.roundToday: Rounds to do planned later today (local day).
def.roundNext7: Rounds to do planned in the next 7 days, after today.
def.pmOverdue: Pending PM occurrences past the end of their tolerance window (or their due date when they have none) — same rule as the PM page.
def.pmNext7: Pending PM occurrences due in the next 7 days.
def.pmCompliance: SMRP indicator: occurrences done inside their tolerance window ÷ occurrences due in the period whose outcome is known (cancelled excluded) — the PM page's figure.
def.toAck: Notifications whose rule asks for an acknowledgement, not resolved and not acknowledged yet.
def.unread: Unread notifications in your inbox (the bell's figure).
def.backlogReady: Planning board jobs with no blocker.
def.backlogBlocked: Planning board jobs with at least one blocker (parts, skills, permits, windows, prerequisites).
def.weekLoad: Labour hours committed this week (Monday–Sunday) ÷ available + overtime hours of the active crews, over the whole week (never a mean of daily ratios).
def.weekOverloaded: Crew-days of the week whose committed hours exceed their available hours (days with no hours at all included).
def.scheduleCompliance: SMRP indicator: committed hours whose work order was done by the end of the committed day ÷ committed hours, for commitments ending in the period.
def.slaBreached: Open requests past a target (response or resolution), paused time excluded (same rule as the request lists).
def.slaAtRisk: Open requests past the escalation threshold, not yet past their target.
def.slaPaused: Open requests waiting for the requester or deferred: the clock is paused.
def.slaClosing: Requests closed in the period (with or without a work order) with no target missed, pauses excluded ÷ closed requests that had a target.
def.backlogOpen: Work orders whose work is still ahead (draft to on hold), by the EN 13306 nature of their type and by urgency level.
def.woOverdueAll: Work orders past their planned end, neither closed nor cancelled (the work order dashboard's figure; a completed but not closed work order counts).
def.planned: Work orders of a preventive or improvement nature (SMRP planned work).
def.reactive: Work orders of a corrective nature (immediate or deferred).
def.emergency: Immediate corrective maintenance work orders (part of reactive).
def.stockReorder: Article × warehouse lines whose available quantity is at or below the reorder point (or under minimum stock) — the Inventory replenishment rule.
def.stockOut: Of those lines, the ones with nothing available.
def.permitsOpen: Permits issued, active or suspended and not expired.
def.permitsExpiring: Open permits expiring within the lead time of the “Permit expiring” rule (Reference data → Notifications).
def.permitsExpired: Permits past their expiry that are neither closed nor handed back.
def.locks: Isolation points applied whose lock removal is not verified yet, whatever the permit's status.
def.criticalDown: Equipment at the highest criticality level of the reference list ({{level}}) whose status is marked “down” ({{statuses}}).
def.diOpenByStatus: Requests neither closed nor turned into a work order, by status, with their average age since submission (the request page's figure).
def.chartPm: PM occurrences due that day, cancelled excluded.
